description: Label format for held-out test set to measure VLM accuracy before fine-tuning.

split.note: Do NOT use for training. Held-out only.

required_fields.crop_id: string - one of: wheat, rice, cotton, sugarcane, maize, tomato
required_fields.disease_id: string - taxonomy disease_id or healthy or unknown
required_fields.severity: string - Low or Moderate or High or N-A for healthy
required_fields.label_confidence: string - high (agronomist-reviewed) or medium or low (field worker)
required_fields.image_quality: string - good or fair or poor
required_fields.notes: string - optional free-text field conditions or anomalies

example.notes: Classic stripe pattern, mid-canopy leaf, Faisalabad field.
